system.description:
Roll Luck instead of the normal Core Skill on checks against Fear, being Intimidated, Confusion, and any other check the Director rules you're too oblivious to notice.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.58
system.summary: Roll Luck instead of the normal Core Skill on checks against Fear, being Intimidated, Confusion, and any other check the Director rules you're too oblivious to notice.

automation.note: Resisting Intimidation, Confusion and other checks the Director allows: switch the skill to Luck in the roll dialog. The Fear Check dialog can't change skill, so roll a Luck Check from your sheet instead and have the Director apply the Fear result.
